title: Sales Executive
shortDescription: Grow our pharmacy and retailer network in Lahore, present our product range and hit monthly distribution targets.
description: BioNature is expanding its distribution footprint across Punjab. As a Sales Executive you will visit pharmacies, clinics and retail outlets, present our product range (GYN-GUARD, Misaka and Laxity), on-board new retailers and strengthen relationships with existing accounts. This is an excellent entry-level opportunity for fresh graduates who enjoy field work and customer interaction.
responsibilities: Visit assigned pharmacies, clinics and retail stores daily
Present product range, composition and pricing to retailers
On-board new outlets and maintain an updated dealer list
Achieve monthly sales and distribution targets
Collect market feedback and competitor information
Ensure timely collections and accurate order reporting
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business or a related field
Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply
Good communication and presentation skills in Urdu and English
Own motorcycle and a valid CNIC
Comfortable with daily field travel within Lahore
benefits: Paid training and product knowledge sessions
Career growth path to Senior Sales / Area Manager
